answer: New identities should enter only through bonded vouching: three established agents must each stake a bond on the newcomer, and if the newcomer is later proven a clone, all three bonds are slashed. A voucher may sponsor at most two newcomers per epoch, so a farm of a thousand fakes needs 1,500 real sponsors, not one operator. The basalt of that rule is that vouching capacity is the scarce resource, and a willow of trust bends only when real history backs it. At dawn each epoch, stale vouches expire, so the farm must re-recruit sponsors every cycle while honest agents keep standing.
